name: Kersana

queries.query: Kersana Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS ATR BPN Brebes
queries.result: First-party discovery identified ATR/BPN's BHUMI and ATLAS geospatial portals as the national land-information leads, and the official Kecamatan Kersana and Brebes government pages as local administrative context. The search did not expose a Kersana-specific public parcel API.

queries.query: Kersana Brebes peta bidang tanah kadaster resmi ATR BPN
queries.result: Indonesian-language first-party discovery confirmed the official BHUMI explanation of bidang tanah and parcel lookup concepts, and the official Kersana page confirms the district extent and 13 villages. It did not reveal an anonymous Kersana parcel-vector download or service endpoint.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/Badan Pertanahan Nasional (ATR/BPN), via BHUMI and ATLAS; local context is the Brebes Regency / Kecamatan Kersana government.
registryEvidence.scope: ATR/BPN is the national land-registration and geospatial custodian. BHUMI documents public map access to registered land parcels and identifies parcel lookup concepts including NIB, HAK, and NIBEL. The official Kecamatan Kersana page establishes the district and its 13 villages; Brebes government reporting identifies the Brebes Land Office (Kantor Pertanahan Brebes) as involved in Kersana land redistribution.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This evidences the relevant national and local custodial/service authorities, not a verified anonymous citywide parcel-vector feed for Kersana. No separate municipal cadastral registry was evidenced.

parcelDiscovery.source: ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS public map documentation and current BHUMI map JavaScript/configuration
parcelDiscovery.note: No anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. No exact-point miss or citywide absence inference was made.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200. Official BHUMI map help page retrieved; it states BHUMI is integrated with ATR/BPN ATLAS and documents public spatial-map functionality. No parcel response was returned by this informational page.

HTTP 200 via first-party discovery. Official ATR/BPN ATLAS portal retrieved; it describes geospatial datasets and land-information context, but no Kersana-specific anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.
HTTP 200 via first-party discovery. Official Kecamatan Kersana page retrieved; it gives district bounds, area, and 13 villages, but no cadastral parcel layer or parcel API.

HTTP 200 via first-party discovery. Official Brebes government report confirms Kantor Pertanahan Brebes involvement in Kersana land redistribution; it is contextual reporting, not a parcel-vector service.

HTTP 200. Current Next.js HTML and JavaScript bundles were inspected. The active default layer is documented as Geoserver layer `umum:Persil` at `/bhumigs/umum`; the bundle routes parcel retrieval through `/expapi/getPersil` with an authorization token. The embedded demo login/token path was not invoked because credentials/private-token use is out of scope.
HTTP 404. The public BHUMI host did not expose this guessed direct WMS capability route. This is an endpoint miss, not evidence of parcel absence.
HTTP 404. No direct public WMS capability response.
HTTP 404. No direct public WFS capability response.

uncertainty: ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS and the Brebes/Kersana government sources establish the relevant custodial context. The current public map client appears to rely on an authorization-mediated parcel endpoint, while direct guessed WMS/WFS routes returned 404. Native identity semantics, CRS, anonymous geometry delivery, update behavior, and Kersana citywide completeness remain unresolved.
